svg.aria-label: An animated example week. Brote and the status line change day by day: Monday plenty of room, Tuesday tired, Wednesday drained as use runs ahead of the week, Thursday tired, Friday tight, Saturday and Sunday on pace. The week ends at 88 percent of the limit used. The numbers are illustrative
